recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Any future richer HLA reporting example should be handled in the Clinical Genomics IG or another current genomics artifact, not by restoring the removed core DiagnosticReport profile/example.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics request from the DSTU2 cycle asking for a better HLA example, resolved to put the HLA usage example back in XML, replace the old example with new bundles, and modify genomics IG material.
initial_application: Commits 134dcc3487 and d0a04fd9cb applied the request in core by updating source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-hla-genetics-results-example.xml and related DiagnosticReport spreadsheet/profile material for the HLA genotyping report example.
additional_context: The affected DiagnosticReport HLA profile, extensions, and example were later removed from current core source by commit 3cfe12f1b4 as outdated clinical genomics artifacts. Current fhir.ini still keeps DiagnosticReport and MolecularDefinition active, but there is no active HLAResult profile entry or old HLA DiagnosticReport example; source/genomics.html now directs implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG and current molecular-definition work, and HLA extension definitions appear in the FHIR Extension Pack rather than core.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding or editing the retired DSTU2-era DiagnosticReport HLA bundle in core would reverse a later intentional cleanup and would not fix a current build artifact.
